title: refactor: dashboard uses the account API for keys, balance and quests
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
The dashboard uses the public account API (`/api/account/*`) for keys, balance, quests and earnings, so apps and agents with API keys can do the same things. Login is unchanged: the dashboard still sends its cookie. Split out of #16563, which adds the session token on top.

- Adds `PATCH /account/keys/:id` and removes `/api/api-keys`. Better Auth's native `/api/auth/api-key/*` routes are blocked
- Removes `/api/customer`: balance comes from `/account/balance`, and weekly earnings sum `/account/earnings?days=7`. The unused `developer_earnings_today` pipe is deleted; remove it from Tinybird prod after release
- Quest rewards, check and claim move from `/api/quests/*` to `/account/quests/*`. The catalog and standings stay put
- Model usage stats move from Enter `/api/model-stats` to Gen `/models/stats` (public, no auth)
- Docs: `account:keys` is account admin (it can edit every key); grant it rarely

gist.headline: One account API, more hands
gist.blurb: The dashboard and API-key-powered apps share the same account paths for keys, balance, earnings, and quest rewards. Even the dashboard has to use the front door.
gist.summary: The dashboard switches to the public /api/account/* API for keys, balance, seven-day earnings, and quest checks and claims, adding PATCH /account/keys/:id while moving public model stats to Gen’s /models/stats.
gist.impact: Apps and agents with API keys can use the same account operations as the dashboard; login stays cookie-based, and the account:keys scope can edit every key, so it should be granted sparingly.
